name: get_paideia_folder_contents
description: Queue a live, read-only inspection of one Moodle folder and return its visible nested files through get_paideia_job_status. Does not download files. Includes live-clock academicContext from the curated KIT PUCP calendar registry. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true, refresh the registry with get_academic_calendar and report a missing term honestly; use set_academic_calendar only as a temporary local fallback.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
